List the releases of a traits.build database

Source: R/list_versions.R
list_versions.Rd

Finds every release of a database on its repository, given the doi of any one of them or the doi of the whole record (a Zenodo concept doi, or a Figshare doi without a version). Pass a release's doi to load_database() to load it. Zenodo and Figshare records are supported.

Usage

list_versions(doi)

Arguments

doi

character string - a doi of the database, e.g. AusTraits' concept doi "10.5281/zenodo.3568417", or the doi of one of its releases

Value

a tibble with one row per release, newest first: version (as recorded on the repository, e.g. "v7.0.0" on Zenodo or "3" on Figshare), doi (the release's own doi) and publication_date. A release whose files are restricted is listed too, though load_database() cannot download it.

See also

load_database(); austraits::get_versions(), which calls this for AusTraits and keeps a copy of the list for offline use

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# The releases of AusTraits
versions <- list_versions("10.5281/zenodo.3568417")
versions

# Load the newest
austraits <- load_database(doi = versions$doi[1])
}
